author: homeless_potato43
body: It adds demonforge and more follower spaces. If you need either of those then build it otherwise you can wait a bit and be fine

author: Nothammer87
body:
You should.build it asap.
You unlock a goldstash, which gives you some %interest each day.
Pretty usefull in low levels.
And it unlocks a stash for followers, you bought.
Otherwise you lose them.
If you want to test other followers or change your specs regularly, you need it to save a lot of gold or orns.
Both can be upgraded with  building level.

And it unlocks a bonus dungeon exclusive to you. Good for farming.


The rest like a demonforge comes much later. That's for higher levels.
